verdict.rationale: Brex ships AI-powered features (expense assistant, invoice automation, an MCP server), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a policy or control that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. Community discussion of Brex using OpenAI's API does not address training-data controls, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
